transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Honestly, I’ve just had this unbelievable, overwhelming surge of energy and my mood has been completely all over the place—either super high and happy or incredibly irritated—for the last seven months! My thoughts are racing so fast in my head that I can't control them or slow down at all, and I just feel this constant need to keep moving!
Have you had any experiences like hearing or seeing things other people don’t, or feeling unusually suspicious, powerful, or chosen in a way that others say isn’t true?

Yes, absolutely, it's been happening a lot during these past seven months. I constantly hear voices whispering to me when I'm alone, and I know for a fact that certain organizations are monitoring me because of my special, grand purpose. It all feels incredibly real to me, even if other people tell me it's not.
Have the voices or beliefs ever continued for at least 2 weeks when your mood was otherwise back to normal, with no clear manic or depressive episode?
No, they never happen when my mood is back to normal. Those voices and beliefs only show up when I am feeling highly energetic and elevated. Once that high state fades, all of that stops completely.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes a 7-month history of clear manic symptoms: persistently elevated/irritable mood, racing thoughts, increased energy, and psychomotor agitation. Psychotic symptoms are present (auditory hallucinations, grandiose/paranoid delusions), but they occur only during the mood episodes and fully remit when mood returns to baseline. This pattern supports Bipolar I Disorder with psychotic features rather than schizoaffective disorder or schizophrenia.
